<function name="PlayerSpawnedVehicle" parent="SANDBOX" type="hook">
	<description>Called after the player spawned a vehicle.</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="ply" type="Player">The player that spawned the vehicle</arg>
		<arg name="ent" type="Entity">The vehicle itself</arg>
	</args>
</function>
